long.description:
Which conspiracy theories turned out to be true? Meatball investigates four that are documented in declassified files: the CIA's Acoustic Kitty spy cat, the Gulf of Tonkin attack that never happened, Operation Northwoods, and Project MKUltra. Sources are in the description; every claim is from public records.
